ContentLayoutDiagnosticsReport.title: Content layout diagnostics report
ContentLayoutDiagnosticsReport.description: The well-formedness and resolvability report for a layout, produced by `LayoutDiagnostics` and normalized for the wire. `wellFormed` is the persistence-gate predicate; `resolvable` is the serving-gate predicate. Both are derived from `violations`: each violation carries a `scope` and `severity` derived from its `code`.

wellFormed.description: True when there are no intrinsic-scope error violations. This is the predicate that gates persistence.

resolvable.description: True when there are no binding-scope error violations. Meaningful only when the layout was bound to a source (via `entityType`/`section` on the draft routes, or the layout's real bindings on the persisted routes); this is the predicate that gates serving.

violations.description: Every defect found in the layout, in no guaranteed order.

ContentLayoutViolation.title: Content layout violation
ContentLayoutViolation.description: A single defect found in a layout, addressed by element id plus an optional property/context key. `scope` and `severity` are derived from `code` and are always consistent with it.

code.description: The defect code. Intrinsic-scope codes (`unregistered_component`, `duplicate_element_id`, `invalid_config`, `mismatched_reference_type`, `mismatched_property_type`, `unknown_style_option`, `orphaned_provider`) describe the layout in isolation; binding-scope codes (`unresolved_required`, `ambiguous_required`, `broken_required_chain`, `unresolved_optional`, `unfilled_required_input`) describe resolvability against a bound source. `mismatched_reference_type` flags a stored reference wiring whose resolved produced type is not assignable to the property's declared FQCN. `mismatched_property_type` flags a stored property value that disagrees with the primitive type its element type declares for that key; `key` carries the property name. `unknown_style_option` flags an element `style` entry naming an option the style option registry does not know; `key` carries the option name. `unfilled_required_input` flags a required reference whose stored wiring references an element property that holds no value.

scope.description: Whether the defect is intrinsic to the layout or only meaningful relative to a bound source. Derived from `code`.

severity.description: Whether the defect blocks the corresponding gate (`error`) or is advisory (`warning`). Derived from `code`.

elementId.description: The id of the element the defect was found on. Echoes the id present in the analyzed tree.

key.description: The property or context key the defect concerns, or `null` when the defect is about the element as a whole.

message.description: A human-readable description of the defect.

candidates.description: For resolvability defects, the candidate sources that were considered (for example the ambiguous candidates of an `ambiguous_required`). Empty for defects with no candidate set.

ContentLayoutResolutions.title: Content layout resolutions
ContentLayoutResolutions.description: Per-element property resolutions, keyed by element id. Each value is the list of that element's declared properties with how each is (or is not) filled. Encodes as `{}` when empty (never `[]`). On the mutation routes this is restricted to the affected elements; on the diagnose route it covers the whole tree.

ContentLayoutPropertyResolution.title: Content layout property resolution
ContentLayoutPropertyResolution.description: How a single declared property of an element type at a position is (or is not) filled. A `primitive` property carries a static value typed by `type`; a `reference` property is filled from a candidate source typed by `fqcn`, with `resolved` holding the conservatively chosen candidate (or `null`) and `candidates` the full set.

kind.description: `primitive` for a statically typed value, `reference` for an FQCN-typed value filled from context or a data loader.

required.description: Whether the element type declares this property as required.

type.description: The primitive type name for a `primitive` property; `null` for a `reference` property (which uses `fqcn` instead).

default.description: The declared default value for the property, if any. Any JSON type, or `null` when there is no default.

fqcn.description: The class-string a `reference` property resolves to; `null` for a `primitive` property (which uses `type` instead).

resolved.description: The conservatively chosen candidate that fills this property, or `null` when none could be chosen (no candidate, or an ambiguous set).

candidates.description: Every candidate source considered for a `reference` property (parent/root providers first, then data loaders). Empty for a `primitive` property.

ContentLayoutResolutionCandidate.title: Content layout resolution candidate
ContentLayoutResolutionCandidate.description: One possible source for filling a `reference` property: an ancestor/root context provider (`origin: parent`), a data loader (`origin: loader`), or the element's own applied wiring (`origin: stored`, only ever the `resolved` pick, never a `candidates` menu entry). The fields that apply depend on `origin`.

origin.description: Where the candidate value originates: a parent/root context provider (`parent`), a data loader (`loader`), or the element's own applied wiring (`stored`).

contextKey.description: For a `parent` candidate, the context key the value is provided under; `null` for a `loader` or `stored` candidate.

providerElementId.description: For a `parent` candidate, the id of the providing element (or `null` for a root-ambient provider); `null` for a `loader` or `stored` candidate.

path.description: For a `parent` candidate, the optional dot-notation path selecting a nested value from the provided context; `null` for a `loader` or `stored` candidate.

distribution.description: For a `parent` candidate, the distribution strategy the provider uses; `null` for a `loader` or `stored` candidate.

contextType.description: For a `parent` candidate, whether the provided context is a single value or a collection; `null` for a `loader` or `stored` candidate.

loaderSource.description: For a `loader` candidate, the data loader source (see `GET /api/_info/content-system-data-loaders.json`); `null` for a `parent` or `stored` candidate.

configTemplate.description: For a `loader` candidate, the inferable loader configuration seed; `null` when none applies (including for a `stored` candidate).

configComplete.description: For a `loader` candidate, whether the loader config is complete enough to resolve without further input. `false` for a `parent` candidate; `null` for a `stored` candidate (it carries no loader-shaped fields — it is applied wiring, not an environment offer — so clients branch on `origin` before reading it).
